main.description: A named collection of linguistic resource entries. Abstract enough to represent bead Lexicons, FrameNet frame inventories, PropBank frame files, WordNet synsets, morphological paradigm tables, gazetteers, stop-word lists, etc.

description.description: Human-readable description of this collection's scope and contents.

kindUri.description: AT-URI of the collection kind definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

kind.description: Collection kind slug (fallback when kindUri unavailable).

ontologyRef.description: Reference to a pub.layers.ontology defining the type system for entries in this collection.

knowledgeRefs.description: Knowledge graph groundings for this collection (e.g., a published resource release, an ontology node, Wikidata).

metadata.description: Provenance: who curated this collection, with what tool.

licensing.description: Licensing terms governing this collection (supports dual/multi/component licensing).

eprintRefs.description: Eprint records (papers/preprints) describing or associated with this collection.

features.description: Open-ended features describing this collection: size, domain, register, provenance notes, etc.

createdAt.description: When this collection record was created.

languages.description: BCP-47 language tags this record covers. Empty when language is unspecified or unknown.

languageRefs.description: Structured language references (canonical BCP-47 tag plus optional script, region, variety, and role) grounding the languages this record covers.
